item.title: After the brutal joys of Hollow Knight: Silksong, Mio: Memories in Orbit feels like a reprieve and a revelation
item.description: Some games arrive as a burst of sensation and pure delight: a handful of images and emotions and ideas that wordlessly create a mood. This is Mio: Memories in Orbit. This game is Mucha-like hair billowing in zero G. It's a cluster of pearls and twills of off-cut brass twisting around the chill reaches of outer space.
